name: ShutterPress Migrate – Import from NextGEN, Envira, FooGallery and Modula into ShutterPress
author: ShutterPress

sections.description:
ShutterPress Migrate makes switching to ShutterPress Gallery fast and frustration-free. It scans your existing galleries, recreates them inside ShutterPress with proper attachments and metadata, and moves or copies back all your images into the WordPress media library. Perfect for photographers upgrading to a modern gallery system.

If you would like to import from a different gallery plugin, please contact us and we’ll see if we can add support.

About ShutterPress Gallery

ShutterPress Gallery is a performance focused gallery plugin built for photographers. Create fast, responsive galleries with Grid, Masonry and Justified layouts, a modern lightbox, infinite scroll, watermarking, and WooCommerce print and download sales in Pro. Learn more at shutterpress.io and see the WordPress listing at ShutterPress Gallery on WordPress.org.

Supported gallery plugins

  • NextGEN Gallery
  • Envira Gallery
  • FooGallery
  • Modula Gallery
  • GT3 Photo Gallery – Galleries and Elementor Widgets

What gets imported

  • Original images, copied or moved into uploads
  • WordPress attachments and metadata
  • Gallery titles
  • Featured images if available

Controls and options

  • Dry run mode to preview the import safely
  • Choose whether to copy or move source files
  • Set galleries to published or draft
  • Mark migrated galleries to prevent duplicates

Why you’ll love it

Save time, protect your work, and start using ShutterPress Gallery without rebuilding everything from scratch.

Links

  • ShutterPress website
  • ShutterPress Gallery on WordPress.org
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, and upload the plugin zip, or copy the plugin folder into wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ShutterPress Gallery, Import.
  4. Choose file handling, copy or move, select the target status, then click Import.
sections.faq:
What Plugins can i migrate from?

NextGen Gallery, Envira Gallery, FooGallery, Modula and GT3 Gallery.

What is ShutterPress Gallery?

ShutterPress Gallery is the gallery plugin this migrator targets. It focuses on speed, clean design, and tools photographers need, including watermarking, client galleries, and WooCommerce sales in Pro. Website, shutterpress.io, WordPress listing, ShutterPress Gallery on WordPress.org.
